name: project-start-seed-kind-correction
body: `domain.entity.project-start-seed` is an entity (kind=entity) that `requirements.requirement.fast-project-start` drives and `solution.component.project-start-seeder` realises. A domain value stands outside the realised-by surface, so the seeder's realisable domain counterpart is an entity; every realisable narrow domain node in this spec is a group or entity (`domain.entity.runtime-artifact` → components, `domain.entity.tool-path-resolution` → component), while values (`domain.value.canonical-file-identity`, `domain.value.module-identity`) stand alone.
